info.title: Assistant API
info.description:
AI assistant API — A2A protocol (Agent-to-Agent), chat, and workflow management.

**Authentication**: protected endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
The token is set via `--auth-token` / `ASSISTANT_WEB_TOKEN` on the server.

get.summary:
`GET /agent/authenticatedExtendedCard` -- Returns the extended agent card
(same as public for now).

post.summary: `POST /api/agents/{id}/set-default` — set an agent as the default.

get.summary: `GET /api/analytics` — get aggregated usage analytics for a time window.

parameters.name: window
parameters.description: Window in hours. Valid values: 1, 6, 24, 72, 168. Defaults to 24.

get.description:
Supports `w` and `h` query params for on-demand image resizing. Resized
variants are cached on disk. Responds with `ETag` and `Cache-Control`
headers; returns `304 Not Modified` when `If-None-Match` matches.

parameters.name: w
parameters.description: Desired width in pixels (preserves aspect ratio).

parameters.name: h
parameters.description: Desired height in pixels (preserves aspect ratio).

get.summary: `GET /api/audio/{id}` — serve a synthesized audio blob from the in-memory store.
`GET /api/conversations/stream` — SSE stream of conversation list changes.
get.description:
Sends an initial `snapshot` event with the full conversation list, then
pushes `upserted` and `deleted` delta events as conversations change.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: Filter events to a single agent. If omitted, events for all agents are streamed.

200.description: SSE event stream. Events: `snapshot` (full list), `upserted` (single ConversationSummary), `deleted` ({conversation_id})

get.summary: `GET /api/conversations/{id}` — get a conversation and its message history.

delete.summary: `DELETE /api/conversations/{id}` — delete a conversation and all its messages.

post.description:
Accepts a `multipart/form-data` body with a single `file` field.
Returns `201 Created` with the attachment metadata on success.

schema.description: Multipart form for image attachment upload.

400.description: Bad request (invalid MIME type, too large, etc.)

get.summary: `GET /api/conversations/{id}/events` — list command events for the timeline.

post.summary: `POST /api/conversations/{id}/messages` — send a message and stream the response.
post.description:
The response is a `text/event-stream` (SSE) with two event types:
- `event: token` — incremental assistant token (data is plain text)
- `event: done`  — final JSON object: `{"role":"assistant","content":"..."}`

200.description: SSE stream of assistant tokens and final message

get.description:
Replays stored events from `?since` (default 0), then tails live events
if the run is still active.  Closes automatically when the `done` or
`error` event is reached.

Returns:
- `404` if no events exist for `run_id` (run never started or unknown)
- `410` if the run existed but all events have been pruned (TTL elapsed)

post.summary:
`POST /api/conversations/{id}/voice` — upload audio, transcribe it, run
through the orchestrator, and stream the response as SSE.

get.summary: `GET /api/logs` — list recent log entries, newest first.

`GET /api/messages/{id}/audio` — synthesize TTS audio for an assistant
message and return it as `audio/mpeg`.
`GET /api/orgs` — list organizations the user has access to.

post.summary: `POST /api/orgs/{org_id}/catalog` — publish a resource to the org catalog.
`POST /api/orgs/{org_id}/spaces/{space_id}/bindings` — bind a persona to an interface.
`POST /api/orgs/{org_id}/spaces/{space_id}/personas/from-template` — create a persona from a template.
`POST /api/orgs/{org_id}/spaces/{space_id}/subscriptions` — subscribe a space to a catalog item.

get.summary: `GET /api/personas` — list all personas defined on the server.

post.summary: `POST /api/personas/active` — switch the active persona for the session.

200.description: File content (empty string if not yet written)

post.summary: `POST /api/personas/{id}/skill-access/skills` — add a skill to the access list.

delete.summary: `DELETE /api/personas/{id}/skill-access/skills/{skill_name}` — remove a skill from the access list.

200.description: List of skills for the persona

post.description:
Upsert a browser push subscription (endpoint + key material).  Returns
`201 Created` on success.

delete.description:
Remove a push subscription by its endpoint URL.  Returns `204 No Content`
whether or not the subscription existed.

get.description:
Returns the server's VAPID public key as a base64url-encoded string.
The Flutter PWA uses this as the `applicationServerKey` argument to
`PushManager.subscribe()`.

post.summary:
`POST /api/quick-message` — create a new conversation, send a message, and
return the complete assistant response as a synchronous JSON reply.
post.description:
This endpoint is designed for machine clients (Apple Shortcuts, Siri App
Intents, curl, webhooks) that need a single request/response round-trip.

get.summary: `GET /api/traces/{trace_id}` — get a single trace with span breakdown.

`GET /api/users/me` — return the caller's `UserDetail`. Works in any
`auth_mode`.

patch.summary: `PATCH /api/users/me` — update the caller's name and/or email.

post.summary: `POST /api/users/me/api-keys` — create a new scoped API key.

get.summary: `GET /api/users/me/onboarding-status` — check if user has created at least one persona.

post.summary:
`POST /api/users/me/password` — change the caller's password and revoke
all their refresh tokens. The current access JWT keeps working until it
naturally expires; API keys are untouched.
`POST /api/webhooks/{id}/verify` — send a signed test payload to the webhook URL.
post.description:
Always returns HTTP 200; the `success` field in the body indicates whether
the remote endpoint responded with a 2xx status.

post.summary: `POST /message/send` -- Sends a message to the agent (unary).
post.description:
Creates a task, records the user message, transitions to Working, produces
an agent reply, and returns the final task state.

post.summary: `POST /message/stream` -- Sends a message with streaming response (SSE).

200.description: Streaming SSE response; each event is a JSON-encoded StreamResponse

post.summary: POST /oauth/authorize — validate credentials, generate auth code, redirect.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: The `state` value we sent when redirecting to the IdP.

parameters.name: error
parameters.description: Error code (if the IdP denied the request).

parameters.name: error_description
parameters.description: Human-readable error description from the IdP.

303.description: Redirect to client with authorization code

get.summary: GET /oauth/complete — return the authorization code as JSON.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Authorization code from the authorize endpoint.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Client-supplied state (forwarded from the authorize request).

post.summary: POST /oauth/device — initiate the device authorization flow.

get.summary: GET /oauth/device/verify — render page where user enters the code.

post.summary: POST /oauth/device/verify — user approves the device code.
POST /oauth/register — register a new OAuth2 client.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter tasks by current status state.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Max number of tasks to return (1..=100, default 50).

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description: Page token from a previous `ListTasks` call.

parameters.name: historyLength
parameters.description: Max number of messages to include in each task's history.

parameters.name: statusTimestampAfter
parameters.description: Filter tasks with status updated after this timestamp.

parameters.name: includeArtifacts
parameters.description: Whether to include artifacts in returned tasks.

get.summary: `GET /tasks/:id` -- Gets the latest state of a task.

parameters.name: historyLength
parameters.description: Max number of recent messages to include in history.

post.summary: Public webhook trigger endpoint — no auth required.
post.description:
Receives an inbound HTTP POST from an external system and queues a workflow
run with trigger type `Webhook`.  The `token` path parameter is the
per-workflow HMAC secret that acts as authentication.

AgentCapabilities.description: Defines optional capabilities supported by an agent.

extendedAgentCard.description: Indicates if the agent supports providing an extended agent card.

AgentCard.description:
A self-describing manifest for an agent.

It provides essential metadata including the agent's identity, capabilities,
skills, supported communication methods, and security requirements.

capabilities.description: A2A capability set supported by the agent.

defaultInputModes.description: Input modes the agent supports across all skills (media types).

defaultOutputModes.description: Output media types supported by this agent.

description.description: A human-readable description of the agent's purpose.

documentationUrl.description: A URL providing additional documentation about the agent.

iconUrl.description: A URL to an icon for the agent.

name.description: A human-readable name for the agent.

oneOf.description: The service provider of the agent.

securityRequirements.description: Security requirements for contacting the agent.

securitySchemes.description: Security scheme definitions for authenticating with this agent.

signatures.description: JSON Web Signatures computed for this `AgentCard`.

skills.description: Skills represent the abilities of an agent.

supportedInterfaces.description: Ordered list of supported interfaces. The first entry is preferred.

AgentCardSignature.description: Represents a JWS signature of an AgentCard (RFC 7515).

protected.description: The protected JWS header, base64url-encoded JSON object.

AgentDetail.description: Full agent detail, including the serialized agent card.

AgentExtension.description: A declaration of a protocol extension supported by an Agent.

description.description: A human-readable description of how this agent uses the extension.

required.description: If true, the client must understand and comply with the extension.

uri.description: The unique URI identifying the extension.

Declares a combination of a target URL, transport, and protocol version for

tenant.description: Tenant ID to be used in the request when calling the agent.

url.description: The URL where this interface is available.

AgentProvider.description: Represents the service provider of an agent.

organization.description: The name of the provider's organization.

url.description: A URL for the provider's website or documentation.

tags.description: Keywords describing the skill's capabilities.

`Part` represents a container for a section of communication content.

data blob (JSON).

StreamResponse.description:
A wrapper for streaming operations encapsulating different response types.

In SSE, each chunk is one `StreamResponse` serialized as JSON.

Task.description:
`Task` is the core unit of action for A2A. It has a current status and when
results are created they are stored in artifacts. Multi-turn interactions
are stored in history.

contextId.description: Unique identifier (UUID) for the contextual collection of interactions.

history.description: The history of interactions for this task.

id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) for the task, generated by the server.

status.description: The current status of the task.

TaskArtifactUpdateEvent.description: A task delta where an artifact has been generated.

append.description: If true, append content to a previously sent artifact with the same ID.

artifact.description: The artifact that was generated or updated.

contextId.description: The ID of the context that this task belongs to.

lastChunk.description: If true, this is the final chunk of the artifact.

metadata.description: Metadata associated with the artifact update.

taskId.description: The ID of the task for this artifact.

TaskPushNotificationConfig.description:
A container associating a push notification configuration with a specific
task.

taskId.description: The ID of the task this configuration is associated with.

TaskState.description: Defines the possible lifecycle states of a `Task`.

TaskStatus.description: A container for the status of a task.

oneOf.description: A message associated with the status.

state.description: The current state of this task.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the status was recorded.

TaskStatusUpdateEvent.description:
An event sent by the agent to notify the client of a change in a task's
status.

contextId.description: The ID of the context that the task belongs to.

metadata.description: Metadata associated with the task update.

status.description: The new status of the task.

taskId.description: The ID of the task that has changed.

TimeSeriesResponse.description: A single point in a time series.

TokenRequest.description: Standard OAuth2 token request (form-encoded per RFC 6749 §4.1.3).

ToolCallSummary.description: Summary of a single tool invocation within an assistant message.

arguments.description: The JSON arguments passed to the tool.

result.description: The tool's output, truncated to a reasonable display length.

TraceDetailResponse.description: Full trace detail with span list.

UnsubscribeRequest.description: Endpoint URL of the subscription to remove.

endpoint.description: The push endpoint URL to remove.

UserSummary.description: Summary of a user (no sensitive fields).

VapidKeyResponse.description: VAPID public key returned to the client.

public_key.description:
Base64url-encoded uncompressed P-256 public key (65 bytes).

oauth2.description: OAuth2 authentication. Use authorization code flow (interactive) or client credentials flow (machine-to-machine). Tokens are issued as JWTs via the `/oauth/token` endpoint.
